items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...At that time you had Andrew White, Ari Brown, Ryo? Was he playing guitar? [INTERVIEWEE] Ryo Kawasaki? No. It was Marvin Horn, I think he was playing guitar.

ctx.x: So the Elvin Jones Jazz Machine has been stem rolling for several decades. Ken Kimery and I first saw that group in 1980 in Mannheim, Germany. At that time you had Andrew White, Ari Brown, Ryo? Was he playing guitar?
Ryo Kawasaki? No. It was Marvin Horn, I think he was playing guitar.
